# AvatarLookup Image Profile Analysis API
> Official examples for portrait attribute analysis from an image by AvatarLookup.

## Canonical resources
- [Product page](https://avatarlookup.com/products/image_profile): Official Image profile analysis product overview.
- [API documentation](https://avatarlookup.com/api-docs): Canonical request, response, limit, and error contract.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/avatarlookup/image-profile-analysis-api): Official multi-language examples and OpenAPI contract.
- [Registration](https://avatarlookup.com/register): Account registration and API-key access.
- [Pricing](https://avatarlookup.com/pricing): Current product pricing.

## Product facts
- Brand: AvatarLookup.
- Product code: `image_profile`.
- API base URL: https://avatarlookup.com.
- Authentication: X-API-Key request header.
- Input: an image, supplied as image_url, image_b64, or a multipart file field.
- Endpoint: POST /api/v1/image/profile (not /api/v1/check, because the input is not an identifier).
- Output: extra.category, extra.gender, extra.age, extra.skin_color, extra.hair_color.
- Attributes are algorithmic estimates from the image, not verified demographic facts.
- The submitted image is not stored.
- Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Shell.
